The native `storage` DOM event listener (lines 74-82) has no React Native equivalent, so that defensive transport folds into the same module bus and is documented as unavailable (storageEventAvailable:false); bootstrap() still runs once (bootstrapped guard) and both paths funnel into notify() exactly as the source intended.

The hook's defensive on-mount resync effect (lines 130-136) and getServerSnapshot()->false (lines 97-99) are preserved unchanged. No DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components are imported; the file uses only React (useCallback/useEffect/useSyncExternalStore) and native-safe TypeScript.

No unit handling, i18n strings, or visual output exist in this non-visual utility hook, so unit/i18n/visual intent is preserved trivially. Verified with cd apps/native; npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
